categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Orient-chip Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, development, packaging, testing, and sales of high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. Its main product lines include intelligent sensor chips (magnetic sensors, motor driver chips, optical sensors), power management chips, and packaging and testing services. The company follows a Fabless plus packaging and testing business model, integrating chip design with in-house packaging and testing capabilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced analog and mixed-signal IC design technologies, including embedded integrated magnetic sensor H-bridge driver circuits, programmable magnetic sensing system chip architectures, and ultra-low power CMOS sensor signal processing. It has developed over 400 intelligent sensor chip products and 200 power management chip products with key breakthroughs in high reliability, precision, low noise, and integration. The production involves wafer testing, chip packaging (SOP, SIP, DIP, SOT, DFN), and final product testing, supported by ISO9001, ISO14001, IATF16949, and IECQ QC080000 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's products serve a broad range of end markets including smartphones, automotive electronics, industrial control, smart security, medical devices, IoT, and wearable mobile terminals. Key customers include leading smartphone brands, ODMs, and industrial clients. The intelligent sensor chips are widely used in consumer electronics, automotive, industrial automation, and medical instruments, while power management chips target smartphones, computers, wearables, wireless chargers, and smart home devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanghai Orient-chip Technology operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales growth. It also has overseas subsidiaries and sales platforms in Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Singapore, serving international markets. Overseas sales mainly involve power management chips sold to smartphone brands and ODMs. The company’s registered office and headquarters are in Shanghai, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain. It focuses on IC design (Fabless model) and owns packaging and testing production lines, enabling full-process integrated circuit packaging and testing services. Wafer fabrication is outsourced to specialized foundries, while packaging and testing are performed in-house or by external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Shanghai Orient-chip Technology emphasizes continuous innovation in intelligent sensor and power management chips, aiming to lead domestic chip substitution and meet evolving market demands. It invests heavily in R&D (over 25% of revenue), focusing on advanced sensor technologies like 3D magnetic sensors, magnetic angle/encoder sensors, high-precision current sensors, OLED screen bias drivers, and wireless charging SOCs. The company collaborates with academic institutions and innovation centers to accelerate technology breakthroughs and expand product portfolios into automotive electronics, medical testing, and photovoltaic energy storage.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of intelligent sensor chips and power management chips. It also earns income from packaging and testing services for integrated circuits. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales to large customers (mainly for power management chips) and distribution channels (mainly for sensor chips). Additionally, the company receives government subsidies and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Orient-chip Technology competes in a highly competitive semiconductor industry dominated globally by international giants such as Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, and Infineon. Domestically, it holds a leading position among Chinese companies in intelligent sensor chips and power management chips, with products reaching international performance levels. The company focuses on niche markets and leverages its integrated Fabless plus packaging model to differentiate from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 565 million, representing a 24.36% increase year-over-year, driven by recovery in downstream consumer electronics. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 52.3 million due to intensified market competition, increased R&D expenses, and asset impairment provisions. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets around RMB 2.65 billion and equity of RMB 2.44 billion. R&D investment remains high at over 25% of revenue, supporting long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and integrated Fabless plus packaging and testing business model to deliver high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective semiconductor solutions. Its intelligent sensor chips and power management products offer advanced features such as high precision, low power consumption, and integration, tailored for diverse applications from consumer electronics to automotive and industrial sectors. The company’s focus on domestic chip substitution and collaboration with innovation centers further strengthens its competitive edge.
